title: fraxinus americana var. epiptera
intro: Fraxinus americana var. epiptera, commonly known as the American white ash, is a deciduous tree belonging to the Oleaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus americana var. epiptera include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its medicinal uses. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic compounds, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
